mainSlogan: Zenerate all possibilities of building design to maximize your success.
teamSummary: Zenerate is a team of architects, designers, A.I. developers, and software engineers.
serviceSummary: In Spring 2020, architectural designer Bongjai Shin and Ph.D. in mathematics and A.I. developer Gahye Jeong co-founded their firm, Zenerate Inc., secured their seed funding from three venture capital firms, offering building design AI services to the Korea and US markets. They are pioneering a new path in the real estate development industry with unprecedented ways of transforming building design problems to mathematics and algorithm problems.
visionContent: In the era of artificial intelligence, how much more profit can we make if we use it for real estate development? Zenerate began with this question. We're pioneering a new path in the real estate development industry with unprecedented ways of transforming building design problems to mathematics and algorithm problems. Our building design AI solution will generate and analyze various scenarios to contribute to your real estate development business with the most profitable alternative.

solutionsDescription: We provide AI-based building design solutions for real estate development. Depending on client’s needs, we can deliver various alternatives including the most efficient, profitable and/or cost-effective ones. By exploring all possible design alternatives with algorithms, we maximize profits of your  development project. Check out our company introduction video below.
partnershipDescription: Zenerate has been partnering with various firms; real estate developers and investors, operation companies, design firms, general contractors, and so forth. Please click here for business Inquiries.

contents: By providing millions of building design alternatives with algorithms, users can easily examine profitability of their projects.
Zenerate provides all possible design alternatives considering site, massing, floor height, view, etc., and maximize profits of the client’s project.
Based on actual transaction data,  our A.I. model learns how the price is decided in relation to  area, floor, height, view, etc.. Then, it will price every single space properly in a new project.
